verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents event webhooks and a guide to wiring those webhooks into Zapier, but Zapier provides the rule and action engine. Rainforest itself has no documented feature for defining event-triggered rules. Webhooks are a developer building block and Zapier is an external workaround, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
